style: Fine ink and watercolor with varied theme-specific backgrounds: coastal blue, coral sunsets, forest green, overcast gray, night interiors; do not default every case to ivory/sage. Preserve the existing two cases. Afterglow uses burgundy, cobalt, copper, emerald and aubergine theatrical backgrounds with a dark five-act cue-folio framework. SWATCH uses sunny industrial cobalt, yellow, tangerine, mint, coral and violet, with a perforated specimen-card index rather than theatrical folios.
